**Task brief for `vcpolish`: audit finding 2A on [flutter/flutter#196561](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561)**

- **Source:** This finding comes from the playground audit of #196561. The auditor built a playground app against the PR in 28 configurations. It was not posted as a PR comment, so there is no URL. Below are the report's method line and section 2A, copied word for word.

  Method section:
  > **Verification**: Every output APK in `build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/` and `build/app/outputs/apk/` was inspected with `aapt2 dump badging`.

  Section 2A:
  > ### 2A. Following the error message's `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` suggestion when no `versionCode` exists builds **un-installable APKs (`versionCode=''`)**
  >
  > When neither `android {}` nor `src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` sets a `versionCode`:
  > - **Flutter 3.47**: Used `-1` (`variant.mergedFlavor.versionCode`) and silently built APKs with `versionCode='999'`, `'1999'`, `'3999'` (`1000 * abi + (-1)`).
  > - **PR #196561**: Fails cleanly (big improvement!), and prints:
  >   > `Set versionCode = flutter.versionCode in defaultConfig (or on each product flavor), or pass -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true to keep one versionCode.`
  >
  > > [!CAUTION]
  > > **Escape-Hatch Trap**
  > > If the developer follows the second suggestion on that exact project:
  > > ```bash
  > > flutter build apk --debug --split-per-abi -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true
  > > ```
  > > the build **exits `0`** and writes `app-armeabi-v7a-debug.apk`, `app-arm64-v8a-debug.apk`, and `app-x86_64-debug.apk` with **`versionCode=''` (empty / missing in the compiled binary `AndroidManifest.xml`)**. `adb install` rejects those APKs on Android devices. Saying *"to keep one versionCode"* when no `versionCode` exists anywhere misleads the user into producing broken APKs.

- **Claims and evidence:** None of these claims comes with raw command output. The report gives conclusions only. I have not reproduced any of them. Reproduce each claim yourself before you act on it.
  1. *On PR head `7233196849d`, a project with no `versionCode` in `android {}` or in `src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` fails the `--split-per-abi` build and prints the message quoted above.* Not reproduced.
  2. *Running `flutter build apk --debug --split-per-abi -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` on that same project exits `0` and writes three split APKs.* Not reproduced.
  3. *Those APKs show `versionCode=''` in `aapt2 dump badging`, and the attribute is missing from the compiled manifest.* Not reproduced. The method line says the auditor used `aapt2 dump badging`, but the report includes no output. Also run `aapt2 dump xmltree --file AndroidManifest.xml <apk>` to tell an empty attribute from a missing one.
  4. *`adb install` rejects those APKs.* Not reproduced. Nothing in the report shows that anyone tried an install. The method line covers only `aapt2`. If you have no device or emulator, report this claim as "not reproduced". Don't assert it either way.
  5. *Flutter 3.47 (the PR's base) built `versionCode` values 999, 1999 and 3999 for this project.* Not reproduced. This is background, but it matters for item 2 of the task.

- **Task:**
  1. Reproduce claims 1–4 on head `7233196849d` with a minimal project that matches the scenario: no `versionCode` in `android {}` and none in the main manifest.
  2. Run the same `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` build on the PR's base commit. Tell me whether the empty `versionCode` comes from this PR or already existed with the flag. Don't widen the PR's scope until I've seen that answer.
  3. If it reproduces, decide whether this needs a code change, a change to the error message, tests, docs, or a mix. Don't settle on rewording the message until you've checked whether the build itself should behave differently when the flag is set and no `versionCode` exists anywhere. If the behavior is wrong, the code may need to change, not just the text.
  4. If you change behavior or the message, add or update a test that covers this exact configuration: no `versionCode` anywhere, `--split-per-abi`, and the force flag.
  5. If it does not reproduce, decline the finding and show the commands and output that prove it.

  Report the following to me:
  - each command you ran, with its exit code and the relevant output (build log tail, `aapt2` lines, `adb install` result or "not reproduced")
  - whether the bug is introduced by the PR or already existed
  - your decision: changed, modified or declined, with the reason
  - the new head SHA, if you pushed

- **Constraints:**
  - Work only on branch `vcfix-manifest-fallback`, and only on finding 2A. Other audit findings will reach you in separate briefs, so don't fold them in here.
  - Push only to the `reidbaker-agent` fork. If you find this branch lives on `flutter/flutter`, stop and tell me before you push.
  - Never rebase. Merge `main` into the branch if you need to update it.
  - Before you push, run the relevant Gradle/flutter_tools tests and analysis and check that they pass.
  - The audit is agent-generated and is not a PR thread, so there is nothing to reply to on GitHub. Don't post a reply to any human reviewer's comment on #196561. Draft any such reply locally and send it to me.
